decisions.reason: As a finish-led extension of the core drainage portfolio, it remains easy for the firm to produce, market and refine with existing knowledge, though demand can still shift with design preferences.
This shower channel is very close to the firm's established drainage know-how and target users, so absorptive capacity is high and continued improvement is more likely than withdrawal.

The pump-assisted solution is more complex and support-intensive than standard drains, but it still builds on the firm's drainage expertise and in-house R&D, which supports further learning rather than exit.

Although still early and somewhat uncertain commercially, this pump-drain shower channel fits the firm's adjacent technical capabilities and dedicated launch effort, making retention more likely while the firm gathers market feedback.
